Looking at the validation errors, I can see two issues:

1. **"block" is not allowed in genre block** — In the block genre, you don't declare nodes using a `block` keyword. You just state the id and label directly.

2. **"edge needs an operator"** — Each edge declaration must include a directional operator like `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`.

Based on the error messages and the FigDown documentation structure, here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

poller "Poller"
healthprobe "Health Probe"
normalizer "Normalizer"
buffer "Ring Buffer"
exporter "Exporter"

edge poller -> normalizer
edge healthprobe -> normalizer
edge normalizer -> buffer
edge buffer -> exporter
```

The key changes:
- Removed the `block` keyword — nodes in the block genre are declared as `id "Label"` only
- Added `->` directional operators to each edge to show data flowing in the pipeline direction
- Kept all five component IDs (poller, healthprobe, normalizer, buffer, exporter) and their labels as specified
- Maintained all four connections as described in the requirements
